stem: A room meets its target average top-canopy PPFD but lower flower quality varies strongly by position. What is the best next measurement plan?
choices: Map light and environmental gradients at multiple canopy heights and positions and compare them with architecture and flower outcomes
Use plant height alone as a substitute for measurement
rationale: Average top-canopy values can conceal substantial vertical and horizontal gradients. Spatial measurements are required to connect architecture and microclimate to flower outcomes.
